#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

bool can(long long n, long long m) {
    vector<long long> digits(32, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        digits[i] = m % n;
        m /= n;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        if (digits[i] <= 1) continue;
        if (digits[i] == n || digits[i] == n - 1) {
            digits[i + 1]++;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << (can(n, m) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
